title: First occurrence in a sorted array
prompt: Specification: Given a sorted array arr of length n and a value x, return the index of the first occurrence of x, or -1 if x is absent. Four candidate implementations follow. Which candidate satisfies the specification for all valid inputs? Select one candidate.

evidence.title: Candidate executions against the test suite
evidence.body:
Each candidate was executed against the same test suite.

Test 1: assert first([1,2,3,4,5,6,6],6,6) == 5
Test 2: assert first([1,1,1,2,3],1,5) == 0
Test 3: assert first([1,2,3],1,3) == 0
Test 4: assert first([1,2,3],4,3) == -1
